$comment: How the codemie-web stack names, places and shares its assistants. Operator, 2026-09-28: 'Do not share agents codemie web with the Team until we have made brownfield and greenfield green with this new provider. Keep agents local, to my name only. but use a common naming for agents "Pipeline [codeline] [agent name]".'
$project: The CodeMie project the assistants and plugin integrations live in. Empty = the operator's personal project, read from the CodeMie login (the SSO username). Never a team project until the operator says so.
$shared: false until a green greenfield AND a green brownfield run on this stack, and then only on the operator's word.
$nameTemplate: {codeline}: the lane's codeline, or the project name for an agent that serves the whole project (ingest, mint, roster review). {agent}: the seam, or the minted role.
$pluginEngineUri: The CodeMie plugin engine the local plugins connect OUT to (codemie-plugins' own default; proven against codemie.lab.epam.com 2026-09-28).
$pluginConnectSeconds: How long a starting plugin has to signal ready (plugin_host.py's ready file) before the call fails. EPAM_CODEMIE_PLUGIN_CONNECT_MS overrides it (tests).
$searchMaxMatches: The most matches a read-only plugin's search returns in one call; beyond it the answer says how many more there were (never a silent cut). 0 = no limit.
$whyNamePrefix:
Operator, 2026-09-30: every assistant a run creates carries its project's tracker prefix ([AMSD] ...). The key is the project's own (projects/

/config.env, exported by load_project_env); this names only the variable and the form. No key, no prefix.

platformLimits.$source: Measured 2026-09-30 (memory pj_codemie_output_truncation_cause). outputTokensPerTurn: one call via `codemie proxy`, claude-opus-5, no max_tokens -> finish_reason length at completion_tokens 4096 (LiteLLM DEFAULT_ANTHROPIC_CHAT_MAX_TOKENS); the assistant API cannot send a limit. visibleTokensObservedMin + charsPerTokenObserved: the shortest cut assistant answer (AMSD-2974 run 3 roster-specialiser, 7,709 chars = 1,744 tokens by count_tokens) — the rest of the turn's budget is spent on something the API does not show. agentSteps: CodeMie AI_AGENT_RECURSION_LIMIT (configs/config.py). requestSeconds: CodeMie LLM_PROXY_TIMEOUT. A final text answer over the budget is cut and still returned success:true (the truncation check runs only on tool-call turns); a tool-call turn over it, or a loop past agentSteps, returns success:false with the message in `generated`.
platformLimits.$consumers: test/mock-agent/codemie.ts — the rehearsal's CodeMie enforces what the real one does.
